# Psalm 136 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Give thanks to the LORD because he is good — his faithful love lasts forever!

**2** Give thanks to the God above all gods — his faithful love lasts forever!

**3** Give thanks to the Lord above all lords — his faithful love lasts forever!

**4** He alone does incredible miracles — his faithful love lasts forever!

**5** He made the heavens with brilliant skill — his faithful love lasts forever!

**6** He spread the earth out over the waters — his faithful love lasts forever!

**7** He made the great lights in the sky — his faithful love lasts forever!

**8** The sun to rule the day — his faithful love lasts forever!

**9** The moon and stars to rule the night — his faithful love lasts forever!

**10** He struck down Egypt's firstborn — his faithful love lasts forever!

**11** He brought Israel out of Egypt — his faithful love lasts forever!

**12** With a mighty hand and an outstretched arm — his faithful love lasts forever!

**13** He split the Red Sea in two — his faithful love lasts forever!

**14** He led Israel right through the middle — his faithful love lasts forever!

**15** He swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea — his faithful love lasts forever!

**16** He led his people through the wilderness — his faithful love lasts forever!

**17** He defeated powerful kings — his faithful love lasts forever!

**18** He killed mighty kings — his faithful love lasts forever!

**19** Sihon king of the Amorites — his faithful love lasts forever!

**20** And Og king of Bashan — his faithful love lasts forever!

**21** He gave their land as an inheritance — his faithful love lasts forever!

**22** An inheritance to Israel his servant — his faithful love lasts forever!

**23** He remembered us when we were down — his faithful love lasts forever!

**24** He snatched us away from our enemies — his faithful love lasts forever!

**25** He gives food to every living creature — his faithful love lasts forever!

**26** Give thanks to the God of heaven — his faithful love lasts forever!

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **136:1-26**: Twenty-six times: 'His faithful love lasts forever.' It covers creation, the Exodus, the conquest, and daily provision. The psalm's message is simple and relentless: everything God has ever done flows from love that never quits.

— PNEUMA
